verdict.rationale: Recurly Engage's churn propensity modeling is a documented machine-learning feature that gives each subscriber a real-time 1–10 risk score to surface at-risk customers inside the product, which counts as an AI-derived insight from the merchant's own data. Nothing else in the evidence shows AI-generated suggestions or recommendations. The Compass MCP server is an external connection for AI dev tools to Recurly's docs and API, not in-product insights, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: an in-product AI assistant or generated insights/recommendations across billing and revenue data, AI suggestions beyond churn risk scoring, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
